title: Mathad Mathadu Mallige
desc: A floriculturist and a firm believer of Gandhism, opposes the local politicians to secure his plot of land and the injustice against villagers.

title: Bangarada Manushya
desc: Rajeeva is shocked when he finds out that his brother-in-law has passed away leaving his family in financial trouble. He decides to take on the responsibility of supporting his sister's family.

title: Mikheal
desc: The police begin raising suspicions when members of two rival gangs are killed. However, further investigation points towards a doctor who is at the heart of a vicious revenge saga.

title: Mufti
desc: Gana, a police officer, must go undercover to find and kill Bhairathi Ranagal, a crime lord. However, when he realises that Bhairathi's intentions are good, he needs to decide his next step.

title: Choo Mantar
desc: Paranormal team explores haunted Morgan House for treasure, unaware of its dark history of greed, betrayal, and tragic deaths.

title: Mylari
desc: Tired of his dull village life, a young man heads to Bengaluru to make a mark. However, the bustling city overwhelms him, leading to experiences that completely change his life.
